title: Minerva NDE/ADC 31423 NDE 31423
content: I have a bi-level home. When you walk through the entrance door, you either go up a flight of stairs, or go down a flight of stairs. I had to walk by the top of the steps (which has a view of both stairways, and the entrance door) to go to the bathroom. I always glance to the door to see the outdoors. I saw my father coming up the steps from downstairs. I saw the top and back of his balding head and his back as he was coming up the stairs. He was wearing a red checkered insulated flannel coat. I was startled at first, I was home alone, and I thought it was an intruder. But, once he reach the top of the step, I realized that he had no legs, he was floating up the steps, then he disappeared. I told him that this is my home, and I hope he liked it.

elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: I hadn't seen my father for at least seven years before he died. When I seen him at his funeral, I didn't look at his face much. He had a balding head, and had gained a lot of weight since I last seen him.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Uncertain I hadn't seen my father for approximately 7 years
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: I think he wanted to see where his daughter and his grandsons live. My son’s bedroom are all downstairs where he was coming from.
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe I was beat to death by my ex- husband in 1991. I had a near death experience. I knew that the body and soul are separate in death.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: ome to you? Scenes from the world's future God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: because of your experience? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.After the NDE: perience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes After the NDE
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes My ex-boyfriend doesn't believe me, but my best friend said she had a similar experience when her father died.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real I was completely alert. I had no recollection of my father balding, and had not seen his back or the back of his head. I only seen him in a coffin for the past seven years. It was him!
